title: Socially Responsible Data for Large Multilingual Language Models
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. This is a position paper outlining recommendations for socially responsible data collection; it does not present or measure a benchmark.
findings: The paper makes a minor, passing reference to religion, noting that the development of multiple written forms for a language ('digraphia') can be 'often influenced by histories of religious expansions'.
